messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] a short question about Affy 6.0 arrays
parts:
Hi,

no. It can estimate raw CNs, but from there on you're still on your
own. There is a need for defining combined annotation files for SNP
and CN probes; some work has been done, cf. Work in Progress. FYI, as
I am yet not working with 5.0/6.0 it is currently not my top priority.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: a short question about Affy 6.0 arrays
parts:
Hi,

You might have noticed from the recent updates that I am working on
it, and the short answer is that it is getting there. I am running
tests on GenomeWideSNP_6 HapMap data (and a little bit on
GenomeWideSNP_5 although that has a less priority). As of today, I
can basically get raw CN estimates and do segmentation. However, as
you also can guess from the update notes, there are "issues" to be
solved in importing annotation data (chromosomal positions & fragment
lengths), but it is getting there.

So, very soon, it should be possible to preprocess and get
segmentation CNR estimates on 5.0 and 6.0 from aroma.affymetrix *in a
standard way*.

However, this does not mean that there is an optimal method available
for 5.0 & 6.0 as we have to 10K-500K (CRMA). There are/will be plenty
of issues how get the most out of the CN probes now available. As a
start you should expect to just use the SNPs available because they
give (much) more precise estimates.

Hope this helps

Henrik

First, I run Windows (and I develop aroma.affymetrix) and I never ever
utilize the R option '--max-mem-size' (so you should not have to take
such drastic steps).

Second, can you please provide details on your sessionInfo() and
detailed verbose output. In case R dumps, you can create a Verbose
object that writes to file using:

verbose <- Verbose("foo.log", threshold=-50);
timestampOn(verbose);

R and aroma.affymetrix should never ever crash, but at most give error
message, so please give me more details.

Third, FragmentLengthNormalization requires fragment-length annotation
data - what annotation file are you using and where have you put it?

Note, currently only dChip SNP information files are supported, and
the one available for GenomeWideSNP_6 (http://www.dchip.org/) only
contains data for SNPs but not CN probes. For this and other reasons,
I have been working on setting up a UFL binary file format for such
annotation data
(http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/unit-fragment-length-ufl-files),
which will be supported in a future version. Then one can import
fragment lengths from Affymetrix' NetAffx annotation files into UFL
files and aroma.affymetrix can use those instead (of slower dChip
files).

Fourth, a delaying issue is that the fragment-length information in
the existing NetAffx files available for the 5.0 and the 6.0 chip
types are incorrect, cf. the above URL. The other day, I received
other files for 6.0 offline that should fix this problem, so hopefully
I will be able to publish a correct UFL files for 6.0 soon(ish).

Cheers

Henrik
